data.voice_note: Voces: Diego (examinador) y una alumna (Carla, tímida pero valiente).
data.script: Diego: Practice exam! What's your name and surname? … Carla: My name is Carla Quispe. … Diego: How old are you, Carla? … Carla: I'm eleven. My birthday was in June. … Diego: Tell me about your family. … Carla: I live with my mum, my grandpa and my two brothers. … Diego: What do you like doing after school? … Carla: I love drawing. I draw animals — mostly llamas! … Diego: And what do you want to be in the future? … Carla: An artist… or maybe a vet for llamas. … Diego: Perfect answers, Carla! The real exam will be easy for you.
